note: Admin-only Architecture (Modules) workspace. The platform is a set of pluggable modules, not a rigid stack. This is the guide for what exists, what is being built, and what is planned: every feature added to the platform should slot into one of these modules. Each module has its own admin page (left rail navigates between them); the home page shows the overview of all modules. arcv2m1 carries a per-game sub-module store (searchable game dropdown) where each game's LOCKED build spec lives. Every module now carries expectedInput and expectedOutput sections defining its exact contract with upstream/downstream modules. Staff only.

modules.title: Game core
modules.what: The games themselves (Ludo, Ayo Olopon, ...). On-chain ER VRF dice for every seat. Knows NOTHING about points, tiers, or competitions. Emits into arcv2m2 on match finish.

modules.title: Result seam
modules.what: The universal plug-and-play bus. One call per game finish (window.publishGameResult), one subscription for all consumers. Validates/normalizes the envelope, fans to arcv2m3/arcv2m4/arcv2m7.

modules.title: Local points
modules.what: Per-game two-track on-chain ledger: (1) LOCAL PURE — every verified win in that game, unspendable, never diluted, bragging-rights source of truth; (2) LOCAL SPENDABLE — the spendable split drawn down by that game's own in-game spends. Only the 'You' seat ever earns.

modules.title: Global ledgers
modules.what: Site-wide three ledgers: (a) PURE — sum of arcv2m3 local wins across all games, no multiplier, honest cross-game skill total; (b) LIFETIME — every point earned from any source (arcv2m3 + arcv2m5 multiplier + arcv2m6 sources), unspendable; (c) SPENDABLE — the same lifetime total but spendable.

modules.title: Active Tier
modules.what: Monthly subscription bought from M4c spendable. 2x/3x/4x multiplier on base win points, applied as a SECOND kind-1 credit into M4b+M4c only (M4a pure is never multiplied).

modules.title: Point sources
modules.what: Signup bonus, referral, giveaway, social earn. All feed M4b+M4c as kind-1 credits. Never touch arcv2m3 local or M4a pure.

modules.title: Competitions
modules.what: Earn events (daily/weekly/monthly) + leaderboards. Consumes the seam (arcv2m2). Entry from M4c spendable. Deferred until arcv2m1-arcv2m4 stable.

modules.title: Sponsor escrow
modules.what: Optional on-chain escrow plugin for arcv2m7. Brand locks SOL before the event, 30/70 rake at settle. Deferred until arcv2m7 product build.

modules.title: Player inventory
modules.what: On-chain player-owned inventory wallet [gfgassets, player]. Stores media bytes (skins, items, sounds) directly on-chain. Per-game item catalogs (like arcv2m1's game dropdown): Ludo skins, Ayo Olopon sounds, etc. Gasless grant/equip/revoke via session key, sliced reads (dataSlice). arcv2m1 games define their own item catalogs; arcv2m9 owns the wallet infrastructure.

keyRules: Every game ends by emitting into arcv2m2; no game knows about points, tiers, or competitions.
arcv2m3 local points are NEVER diluted: no multiplier, no purchase, no bonus, no giveaway, no referral.
Multiplier (arcv2m5) applies only at arcv2m4 flow-up as kind-1 credits; M4a pure is NEVER multiplied.

Source-tagged: every arcv2m4 credit carries its game/event source. The gameId from the arcv2m2 envelope IS the source identity for game wins — downstream modules must NOT hardcode source strings or duplicate scoring tables.
Modules integrate through seams (arcv2m2), never hard-wires.

BUILD CONTRACT (Input/Output): every module MUST have expectedInput and expectedOutput sections in architecture.json before building. The agent MUST read both sections of a module AND its upstream/downstream modules before, during, and after building. A module that duplicates another module's work (e.g. arcv2m4 recomputing arcv2m3's scoring) is a design bug caught by this contract.

RPC/REGION-AGNOSTIC BUILD RULE (hard, locked 2026-08-18): every on-chain capability built for ANY module MUST be RPC/region agnostic by construction. Concretely: (1) every new per-player PDA type (dice/points/result/global/comp/assets/...) ships its own undelegate instruction in the SAME program build, so any account can leave a flaky/banned ER region and be re-pinned to a healthy one; (2) client/relay/probe code must never assume a single ER endpoint or region — resolve each account's hosting region from the Magic Router (getDelegationStatus -> fqdn) and target it, with the 3-region registry + failover as the base transport (src/gfg-rpc.js); (3) delegate account maps use the relay's camelCase key form (bufferGlobalPoints/globalPoints), never snake_case, for the #[delegate] helper accounts. This is what let the 2026-08-18 US-route ban ("-32005 client temporarily banned") be survived by moving the whole fleet to AS instead of redesigning. Banned/failing region = a re-pin job, not a feature outage.
Build order gates everything: arcv2m1+arcv2m2+arcv2m3+arcv2m4 stable for Ludo FIRST -> arcv2m5 -> arcv2m6 -> arcv2m9 -> arcv2m7/arcv2m8. Never build ahead of the module status.

modules.title: Game core + proof of play
modules.summary: Per-game engine + on-chain ER VRF dice + verifiable roll. Knows NOTHING about points, tiers, competitions. arcv2m1 is ONE module; its game core sub-module arcv2m1A covers every game (Ludo locked now, Ayo Olopon planned next, then 50+) - the dropdown on this page differentiates the games. Each game's LOCKED spec lives there.

expectedOutput.summary: What arcv2m1 MUST emit for downstream modules (arcv2m2 seam consumers) to work. Every arcv2m1 game MUST produce exactly this. Nothing more, nothing less.
items: SEAM ENVELOPE (via window.publishGameResult): the one contract arcv2m1 fulfills. Called once on match finish. Format: { gameId: string (e.g. 'ludo', 'ayo_olopon'), mode: string, startedAt: number (ms), finishedAt: number (ms), players: [{ seat: string (game-local color/position), actor: 'user'|'house'|'local', position: number|null (ranked), score: number|null (score-based), identity: string|null (wallet, resolved by bus for 'user') }], proof: { method: string, chain: string, signature: string|null, pda: string|null } | null }

GAME_ID (critical): the string gameId ('ludo', 'ayo_olopon') is the PRIMARY KEY that arcv2m3 uses to look up scoring tables and arcv2m4 uses as the source identity. It MUST be stable per game, lowercase, no spaces. This is the game's identity on the platform.

PLAYERS ARRAY (critical): every active seat in the match. actor='user' is the signed-in player (only this seat earns arcv2m3/arcv2m4 rewards). position is the ranked finish (1st..nth). The array length determines mode (2P vs 4P). ALL active seats must be present.

PROOF (critical for banking): envelope.proof.signature MUST be a valid on-chain tx signature (the winning roll or match-end proof). arcv2m3 and arcv2m4 use the first 8 bytes as match_ref for idempotency. If proof is null, no downstream module banks anything.

ON-CHAIN PDAs (arcv2m1 manages these, downstream modules read them): PlayerPoints PDA [gfgpoints, game_tag, player] (arcv2m3), GlobalPoints PDA [gfgpoints, 'global', player] (arcv2m4), MatchResult PDA [gfgresult, player, match_ref] (Scope C). These are created/delegated by the relay on first use.

expectedInput.summary: What arcv2m1 NEEDS from the platform to run. arcv2m1 is standalone — it does NOT receive anything from arcv2m3, arcv2m4, arcv2m5, arcv2m6, or arcv2m7. Its inputs are infrastructure, not modules.
items: PLAYER IDENTITY: Dynamic wallet (email OTP sign-in) providing session key for gasless on-chain signing. arcv2m1 never sees raw private keys.
ON-CHAIN VRF: MagicBlock VRF via the ER (ephemeral rollup) for dice randomness. Every roll resolves on-chain, gasless. arcv2m1 calls the VRF through the delegated dice PDA.
SPONSOR RELAY: app-funded sponsor wallet that pays the one-time init+delegate cost per player (~0.0086 SOL for dice+points+result PDAs). After delegation, all rolls are free.
GAME CONFIGURATION: board layout, rules, timing constants (AI speed, roll delays, turn pacing). Each arcv2m1A game has its own LOCKED spec in the games dropdown.
SEAM SCRIPTS: public/universal/result-seam/game-result.js must be loaded BEFORE the game runs, so window.publishGameResult is available when the match finishes.

details: arcv2m1A = the game core sub-module for ALL games (one sub-module, many games). The dropdown below differentiates them: arcv2m1A Ludo (locked), arcv2m1A Ayo Olopon (planned), more later.
Ludo is the first arcv2m1A game (live, on-chain ER VRF dice for EVERY seat). LOCKED 2026-08-15.
ALL rolls resolve on-chain in the game's single delegated ER session (ER VRF queue, gasless, ~50-100ms), bundled with game moves - NO server-side /api/roll house roll in the on-chain build.

Three seat types: 'You' (signed-in user, own delegated dice PDA, session key, manual input); 'Human' (extra local human, on-chain roll like a computer, manual input, no separate session sign-in); 'Computer' (fully automated on-chain, automation itself runs in the ER).
Any seat's roll has NO offline fallback: retry x3 then pause + monitor (never fake roll).
A game emits into the universal result seam (arcv2m2) and knows nothing else. It NEVER knows how points/competitions work.
Pluggable: arcv2m1A Ayo Olopon becomes the next game with the same proof-of-play contract + the same result seam.
Per-game locked specs: see the game dropdown below (arcv2m1A Ludo locked 2026-08-15).

PROOF OF PLAY (verifiable tooling, shipped 2026-08-16): the public /verify/ receipt explorer proves any GlobalFolkGames receipt on-chain, because ER receipts are NOT indexed by public explorers (SolanaFM/Solana only see base + settlement). Signature lookups query BOTH the ER RPC (getTransaction on devnet-us.magicblock.app) and the base devnet RPC (api.devnet.solana.com); account lookups always surface the permanent base-explorer (solana.fm) record plus recent rollup sigs (getSignaturesForAddress). The ludo-lab winners popup gains a 'See on-chain receipt' link opening /verify/?tx=<sig> pre-filled + auto-queried. Honesty rule kept: never link an ER sig on a standard explorer. Lives as arcv2m1 game-tooling (game-adjacent), NOT inside public/universal/ - it is proof-of-play support for arcv2m1 games, not a universal consumer module.

games.title: Ludo
games.summary: LOCKED build spec for arcv2m1A (Ludo). The agent MUST read this before/during any Ludo arcv2m1 build, test against it, and only conclude arcv2m1 for Ludo when the build matches it end to end.
details: DICE - ER VRF for every seat, on-chain: every roll resolves on the MagicBlock ER VRF queue (5hBR...K5Tc, gasless, ~50-100ms). 'You' rolls via the player's own delegated dice PDA (session key signs, 0 SOL). Computer/human seats roll via the server-signed house roll (AMENDED 2026-08-15, owner-approved anti-cheat decision): the app-held sponsor key signs gasless ER VRF rolls on the same queue - the key never leaves the server, so a player can NEVER re-roll the computer's dice until favorable. A client-signed computer roll is impossible to make cheat-resistant on the current ER model (roll and its consumption are separate txs), so the house signer stays server-side. Full on-chain roll+move bundling (Match PDA, auto_computer_move) is a mainnet-phase build.

SEAT TYPES: (1) 'You' = signed-in user seat; roll via the player's own delegated dice PDA, session key signs silently (0 SOL); manual input (tap dice, tap token). (2) 'Human' = extra local human seat (dropdown 'Human', NOT 'You'); roll is ON-CHAIN via the server-signed house roll (sponsored by the app session; NO separate sign-in, NO session key requested); move is MANUAL input by the real human (dice tap + token tap), never auto-played. (3) 'Computer' = fully automated; roll on-chain via the server-signed house roll (AMENDED 2026-08-15: AI decision + token move are client-side in this build, the dice roll is the on-chain proof; auto_computer_move-style on-chain automation is deferred to mainnet and needs a Match PDA). Human-vs-computer timing constants unchanged (deliberate slow AI pace).

MATCH OUTCOMES (AMENDED 2026-08-16): finished = all active seats have all 4 tokens DISAPPEARED OFF THE BOARD COMPLETELY -> game marks status=finished (game state + persisted payload) and emits the seam. The FULL finish order 1st..Nth + reward mirror are committed on-chain by the Scope C consumer (record_result, gasless ER write, proof-bound to the match's proof-roll signature), now WIRED IN-GAME (2026-08-16): win-detection fires it soft-fail on match end and the ceremony shows a copyable receipt plus a working devnet link to the result account's base-layer creation tx when freshly sponsored. arcv2m1 still does NO reward banking itself (record_points is a separate mirror the legacy ludo build uses). ONLY finished earns arcv2m3/arcv2m4 rewards later (rewards gate on status===finished). A dedicated on-chain status field awaits the mainnet-phase Match PDA build. abandoned = End Match button (best-effort on tab close) closes the match in game state as status=abandoned - never rewarded, never emits the seam (this build keeps it client-side + persisted; the on-chain immortalized-abandoned record is mainnet-phase). session lost = browser dies with no tx -> ER session expires -> no permanent record (acceptable).
COMPLETED DEFINITION (confirmed): all active seats must finish. 2P: both seats all 4 tokens home. 4P: all 4 seats. No 'leader wins and match ends' shortcut - rewards stay honest.

ENDGAME BEHAVIOR: (1) auto-skip finished seats - once a seat has all 4 tokens off the board its turns auto-pass (~1.5s log, no dice roll, no tap) for human AND computer seats. (2) auto-complete - when all active seats have all 4 tokens off the board the loop STOPS (result ceremony 1st..4th + 'Play Again'), no infinite cycling, no reset-only ending. (3) NO skip-remaining toggle; End Match is the only speed escape hatch.

PÈ (capture) is UNCONDITIONAL on the common path - fixed + verified (commit 1af91cc, 18/18 checks, both ludo + ludo-lab). Only two safe zones: the 4 colored start boxes (universally safe for any token standing there) and the own-color home lane. Same-color tokens stack. Landing on an opponent with the LAST movable token + LAST die still pè's.

TERMINOLOGY (hard rules): 'disappeared from board completely' = the winning/finished state (stepsWalked >= 57, token at center, hidden) - this is what counts toward finishing. 'locked back in homebox / return home' = the LOSING state after pè (pathIndex -1, needs a 6 to re-enter). 'home safe zone' = the 5 colored boxes before the center (own color only). Two win paths: (a) full 360° circuit into own home lane -> center -> disappear; (b) pè fast-track - capture an opponent -> capturer completes circuit and disappears.
SEAM: arcv2m1 emits the gfg:game-result@1 envelope via window.publishGameResult when the match completes (all active seats finished). arcv2m1 knows NOTHING about points/tiers/competitions.

MATCH MODE (2P / 4P, pre-lock selector): selectable before the match locks via the Players toggle (2 or 4) on the setup panel. 2P plays the classic opposite corners (green + red) only - yellow + blue dropdowns are disabled - and the match completes when BOTH active seats have all 4 tokens home. 4P plays all four seats and completes when ALL FOUR finish. Everything derives from the ACTIVE seats: turn loop, endgame auto-complete, ceremony, and the seam envelope (2 players in 2P, 4 in 4P). matchMode is persisted and restored with the match. Changing mode mid-match is blocked once the match locks.

LOCAL POINTS (arcv2m3 cross-ref, owner-locked 2026-08-16): Ludo's own local scoring = 4P 1st 100 / 2nd 50 / 3rd 10 / 4th 0 (game auto-ends once 3 winners emerge, so 4th earns nothing); 2P only 1st earns 100 (2P auto-ends the moment 1st emerges). ONLY the 'You' (user) seat earns - house and local-human seats earn nothing even if first. Banked by the arcv2m3 universal module (public/universal/points/) via the seam; the game itself does NOT compute or bank points (arcv2m1 stays reward-blind).

games.title: Chess
games.summary: LOCKED build spec for arcv2m1A Chess (MultiNations). The agent MUST read this before/during the Chess build, test against it, and only conclude arcv2m1 for Chess when the build matches it end to end. Chess is fully on-chain for BOTH single player and multiplayer: board, rules, history, and the computer opponent live in the program; the frontend only displays and sends intended moves. Anything not stated in this spec is not built.
details: RULESET (world standard, public domain): implement the FIDE Laws of Chess (the globally used competitive ruleset) in our OWN wording. The rules of chess are facts and procedures and are not copyrightable; FIDE handbook TEXT is copyrighted, so never copy FIDE wording and never use FIDE event names, FIDE branding, or Chess.com branding/assets. Standard Staunton-style pieces only. This is the international chess line (Chaturanga to shatranj to modern chess), NOT Xiangqi, Shogi or Janggi; those are separate games on their own country cards and are never treated as chess skins.

BOARD AND SETUP: 8x8 board, 64 squares, alternating light and dark, a light square in each player's near-right corner. Standard start: rooks, knights, bishops, queen on her own colour, king, then eight pawns. White moves first. Coordinates a1 to h8. Each side: one king, one queen, two rooks, two bishops, two knights, eight pawns.

PIECE MOVEMENT: king one square in any direction; queen any distance in any direction; rook any distance along its file or rank; bishop any distance diagonally and stays on its colour forever; knight jumps in an L (two plus one) and may pass over pieces; pawn moves one square forward, two on its first move, and captures one square diagonally forward (it never captures straight ahead).

SPECIAL MOVES (all required): promotion (a pawn reaching the last rank becomes queen, rook, bishop or knight, player's choice, default queen); en passant (immediately after an opponent's two-square pawn advance, a pawn may capture it as if it had moved one square, only on the very next move); castling (king moves two squares toward a rook and the rook jumps to the king's other side, kingside O-O or queenside O-O-O, allowed only if neither the king nor that rook has moved, no pieces between them, the king is not in check, and the king does not pass through or land on an attacked square).

END CONDITIONS: check is when a king is attacked. A move that leaves your own king in check is illegal and must be rejected. Checkmate (side to move is in check with no legal move) ends the game with a win for the mover. Stalemate (side to move has no legal move and is not in check) is a draw. Draws also by threefold repetition (the same position with the same side to move and the same castling and en passant rights occurring three times), the fifty-move rule (fifty moves by each side with no pawn move and no capture), insufficient material (K vs K, K+B vs K, K+N vs K, K+B vs K+B with bishops on the same colour), and mutual agreement.

FULLY ON-CHAIN MANDATE (single player AND multiplayer): the board, the full move legality validation, the move history, the game status, and the computer opponent ALL live on-chain in the program. The browser is a pure presenter: it sends an intended move (from square, to square, promotion choice) and DISPLAYS the resulting state. There is NO client-side rule authority anywhere. A custom or third-party frontend cannot make an illegal move, cannot fake a result, and cannot play for free. This is stricter than Ludo, where solo AI and move execution are client-side.

LIVES GATE (on-chain, single AND multiplayer): the lives gate is enforced ON THE ER (start_chess_match, and join_chess_match for multiplayer), NOT on the base-layer create. Reason: the board create is a base tx while the lives ledger is delegated (owned by the delegation program on base), so a base-derived Account cannot read it there; the ER start/join write is where the lives PDA is owned by our program, so the gate runs there and the base create is only sponsor rent allocation. The gate passes when the player has an available life and rejects with NoLives when exhausted. One life is consumed ONCE per COMPLETED match (consume_life on completion); abandon, reset, or disconnect never consumes a life. The gate is enforced inside the program, so any frontend, including a third-party one, is bound by it. A third party cannot use this program to bypass lives; if they want different rules they must fork and deploy their own program.

MACHINE ENFORCEMENT (no third-party bypass): the chess create, join, start, move, resign, draw and finish instructions require the lives account and enforce seat authority: only the signer for the side to move can submit that side's move, and only a seated wallet can act for its seat. All rule-relevant and value-relevant checks are on-chain. Browser checks are UX only.

ER ARCHITECTURE: each match creates a chess board account on the base layer, then delegates it to the MagicBlock ER; all gameplay (moves, clock, resign, draw) runs gasless on the ER. Every new per-player PDA follows the additive seed rule and ships its own undelegate_* instruction in the SAME program build (RPC and region agnostic build rule), using a NEW seed prefix (for example gfgchess*) that never changes a live seed or an existing account layout.

EPHEMERAL MOVE HISTORY: the growing move list lives in an Ephemeral Account (ER only, 32 lamports per byte, create, resize, close), so a long game does not pay base-layer rent for history growth. The board state itself is a delegated PDA. The sponsoring account must be delegated before any ephemeral account is created.

CHESS CLOCK (on-chain deadlines plus a permissionless claim_timeout, NO crank): standard time controls with a base time plus increment, chosen from popular-standard presets: 1+0 bullet, 3+2 blitz, 5+0 blitz, 10+0 rapid as the DEFAULT, and 30+0 classical, configurable per match. A safety cap of 300 plies finishes the game as an automatic draw, to bound the history array (a safety bound, never a rule change). Each seat has an on-chain clock and an absolute deadline; every move stamps it and adds the increment. When a seat's clock lapses, ANYONE may call a permissionless claim_timeout (exactly the Ludo expire_turn pattern, in the same program): the program verifies the deadline from on-chain timestamps and finalises the game as a win for the opponent, deterministically, no matter who calls it or how much later. The browser is never trusted to enforce the clock. A MagicBlock crank to auto-trigger the timeout is OPTIONAL and DEFERRED; it is not required for correctness and adds no new program or dependency. Agreed draws are allowed (a mutual offer then accept), matching standard chess.

COMPUTER OPPONENT (on-chain): the AI is produced by the program, never by the client. It is a deterministic light engine: full legal move generation plus a shallow search (material plus simple positional scoring, one to two plies, plus a small opening book), sized to fit the ER compute budget and requesting up to 1.4M compute units per transaction when needed. AI moves are signed by the house/sponsor key (server-side, like Ludo's house roll) so a player can never retry the AI until it blunders. Deeper search and any engine beyond the compute budget are DEFERRED to the mainnet phase. Two difficulty levels are offered: light and standard.

MATCH LIFECYCLE AND STATUSES: created or lobby (status 0), in progress (status 1), finished (status 2). Outcomes: white wins, black wins, or draw. End reasons: checkmate, resignation, timeout or clock, and the draw reasons (stalemate, threefold, fifty-move, insufficient material, agreement). Abandon is not a completion. Only a COMPLETED match emits the seam and can earn; abandoned or disconnected matches never reward and never draw a life.

RESULT SEAM (arcv2m2): on completion the game publishes the gfg:game-result@1 envelope via window.publishGameResult, carrying seat to wallet identity exactly like Ludo's multiplayer, so each logged-in seat is credited at its own wallet. arcv2m1 is reward-blind: it reports the outcome and the finish facts and does nothing about points.

LOCAL POINTS (arcv2m3 cross-ref): chess scoring maps a win to 1st place; a draw shares the position pool so a fair draw is not punished; a loss earns nothing. ONLY a You or logged-in seat earns; house and computer seats never earn. Points are banked by the arcv2m3 universal module via the seam, never by the game. The exact point numbers are locked in arcv2m3 by the owner before the build; the win-as-1st mapping is fixed here.

FRONTEND: display only, mobile first, in the existing brand. Piece rendering MAY use an open-source board and piece set freely for display (drag and drop plus classic Staunton-style pieces), but the frontend holds NO rules authority. It renders the on-chain board and sends intended moves with the session key (gasless). Board coordinates, last-move highlight, check indicator and legal-move hints are UI conveniences derived from the on-chain state (read from the ER or server), never authoritative.

SESSION KEYS AND GASLESS: the player's session key signs moves on the ER (0 SOL, no wallet popups). Onboarding (one-time create plus delegate) is sponsor-paid and bundled with the existing dice, points, result, global, premium and lives PDAs. There is no new per-move cost to the player or the sponsor.

PROGRAM PLACEMENT (SINGLE PROGRAM, owner-locked 2026-09-15): chess ships as ADDITIVE instructions on the SAME gfg program (program id unchanged), never a second program. The chess code lives in its own Rust module file inside the same crate (for example src/chess.rs) so the crate stays organised and one deploy, one IDL, and shared lives and points are preserved. New seed prefix (gfgchess*), versioned account layouts (a version u8 first), a permissionless idempotent migrate_* for any layout change, and an undelegate_* for every new per-player PDA, per the solana-upgrade-safety rule. No live Ludo seed or layout is ever changed. Guardrail: if the .so size or compile time ever becomes a real problem (it is about 1.18 MB today and chess adds little), revisit splitting into a chess module program; the default stays one program.

TESTS (the build benchmark; all must pass before arcv2m1 is complete for Chess): (a) perft-style legal move generation matching known standard node counts for the opening positions; (b) checkmate, stalemate, threefold repetition, fifty-move and insufficient material detection; (c) castling rights plus en passant plus promotion correctness; (d) on-chain rejection of illegal moves (moving into check, wrong seat, out of turn, illegal piece movement); (e) clock plus crank timeout forfeit with no client online; (f) lives gate pass and fail plus exactly one life per completed match; (g) seam emission with wallet-correct crediting; (h) gasless ER writes from a 0-SOL session key. The spec is the benchmark; only an end-to-end match against it concludes arcv2m1 for Chess.

MULTINATIONS CATEGORY: chess is listed under the MultiNations country row (India, Iran, Spain, Italy) on /games and /countries. The prep page (About, Who shaped this board, How to play) already ships; the Play button stays disabled until the on-chain game passes the benchmark.

DEFERRED TO MAINNET (explicitly NOT in this build): staking or entry-fee chess (would use Ephemeral SPL Token custody), private or hidden chess (not needed, chess is perfect information), deeper AI search, tournament pairing and ratings via SOAR, and any matchmaking beyond the existing arcv2m12 multiplayer rail. These are listed only so the build does not drift into them.

DEPENDENCIES: arcv2m1 (game core plus rules), arcv2m2 (result seam), arcv2m3 (points), arcv2m10 (lives), arcv2m12 (multiplayer rail), and the MagicBlock ER (delegation, session keys, ephemeral accounts, compute limits). No crank and no second program are required. Uses the existing sponsor relay and the region-agnostic RPC rules.

BUILD PHASES (LOCKED order; each phase must pass its own tests before the next begins, and no phase starts before the previous one is green): Phase 0 - ON-CHAIN DESIGN: seeds, account structs, instruction set, and the compute-budget plan (design doc approved before any program code). Phase 1 - ON-CHAIN CORE: the board account, full legal move generation, all special moves, and all end conditions, proven perft-correct and gasless on the ER. Phase 2 - SINGLE PLAYER: solo create and start, moves on the ER via the session key, the on-chain light AI, the on-chain lives gate, completion, the arcv2m2 seam, and the arcv2m3 win credit. Phase 3 - MULTIPLAYER: seats, join, seat authority, the arcv2m12 rail adapter, the on-chain clock plus permissionless claim_timeout (timeout forfeit), resignation and draw offers, and finish propagation to every device. Phase 4 - FRONTEND: the mobile-first display board and move input wired to the ER read and write, piece rendering, last-move and check indicators, and legal-move hints. Phase 5 - HARDENING: the full benchmark suite (perft counts, end conditions, castling, en passant and promotion, illegal-move rejection, permissionless timeout with no client online, lives gate, seam crediting, gasless 0-SOL writes), region-agnostic re-pin checks, and the completed A-Z recheck against this spec. arcv2m1 for Chess is called complete only after Phase 5 passes.

modules.title: Universal result seam (the plug-and-play contract bus)
modules.summary: The single integration contract between every game and every reward module. One call per game finish, one subscription for all consumers. Standalone because it is the platform's wiring: 50 games = 1 reward plug, 1 competition plug.

expectedOutput.summary: What arcv2m2 MUST emit after normalizing a game's envelope. Every downstream consumer (arcv2m3, arcv2m4, arcv2m7, future) receives exactly this normalized envelope.
items: NORMALIZED ENVELOPE (emitted to all subscribers via onGameResult callback + gfg:game-result DOM event): { schema: 'gfg:game-result@1', gameId: string, mode: string, startedAt: number|null, finishedAt: number, players: [{ seat: string, actor: 'user'|'house'|'local', position: number|null, score: number|null, identity: string|null }], proof: { method: string, chain: string, signature: string|null, pda: string|null } | null }

GAME_ID PASSTHROUGH: the gameId from the raw emit is preserved exactly. This is the PRIMARY KEY downstream modules use (arcv2m3 maps it to gameTag for on-chain seed, arcv2m4 maps it to source identity). arcv2m2 does NOT modify gameId.

WALLET IDENTITY ATTACHMENT: for every player where actor='user', the bus resolves the connected wallet address and attaches it as player.identity. Downstream modules (arcv2m3, arcv2m4) use this to find the correct on-chain PDA.

VALIDATION: arcv2m2 rejects malformed envelopes with clear error messages (missing gameId, empty players, invalid actor, missing position/score). Games fix their emit; downstream modules never see bad data.
SUBSCRIPTION API: window.onGameResult(handler) → returns unsubscribe function. handler receives the normalized envelope. Also: window.gfgLastGameResult (last result), gfg:game-result DOM CustomEvent.

expectedInput.summary: What arcv2m2 RECEIVES from games (arcv2m1). This is the raw emit that arcv2m2 normalizes.
items: RAW EMIT from window.publishGameResult({gameId, mode, startedAt, finishedAt, players[], proof}): the raw envelope from any arcv2m1 game. gameId is required. players[] must have 1-64 entries, each with seat + (position OR score). proof is optional.
GAME_ID: string identifying the game (e.g. 'ludo'). Must be stable, lowercase, no spaces. arcv2m2 passes it through unchanged.
PLAYERS: array of seat objects. actor defaults to 'local' if omitted. position OR score required per player.
PROOF: optional on-chain proof object. If present, must have method + chain. signature and pda are optional.

details: Standalone module: it does NOT fit under game core (arcv2m1) or any reward module. It is the bus every game emits into and every consumer subscribes to.
Canonical envelope gfg:game-result@1: players[] with seat/actor (user|house|local)/position|score + optional on-chain proof. Implemented in public/universal/result-seam/game-result.js.
Every arcv2m1 game ends with one call: window.publishGameResult({gameId, players, proof}). The bus validates/normalizes, attaches wallet identity to 'user' seats, and fans the result out.

Consumers subscribe via window.onGameResult(handler) + a 'gfg:game-result' DOM event. arcv2m3/arcv2m4/arcv2m7 (local points, global ledgers, competitions) subscribe here and NEVER read game internals.
No game ships its own reward/competition plug. Adding a new game = emit the same envelope; the platform does not change.
Ludo (ludo-lab) now emits this envelope on match completion (replaces the ad-hoc onGfgMatchResult seam).

PHYSICAL HOME (universal/): every universal module lives under public/universal/ (result-seam/ = arcv2m2, points/ = arcv2m3, ledgers/ = arcv2m4, assets/ = arcv2m4 inventory wallet, subscription/ = arcv2m5, point-sources/ = arcv2m6, competitions/ = arcv2m7, escrow/ = arcv2m8). A game plugs in ONCE (window.publishGameResult); a universal module subscribes ONCE (window.onGameResult) and updates inside its own folder without ever touching a game. UNIVERSAL MEANS REUSABLE BY NAME: a universal module is game-agnostic - any arcv2m1 game (Ludo, Ayo Olopon, ...) plugs into it and reuses it; it is NEVER tailored to one game the way arcv2m1 game code is.

modules.title: Local points (per game, PURE + SPENDABLE, on-chain via ER)
modules.summary: Two on-chain local ledgers per game per player, both gasless on the MagicBlock ER: (1) LOCAL PURE (unspendable lifetime): every verified win point ever earned in that game, never diluted, never spent - the native-gamer bragging-rights source of truth; (2) LOCAL SPENDABLE: the spendable split of that same game's earned points, drawn down only by that game's own in-game spends (future shop), never a bragging-rights number. Only the signed-in 'You' seat ever earns; computers and non-You humans earn nothing regardless of position.

expectedInput.summary: What arcv2m3 RECEIVES from upstream modules and infrastructure. arcv2m3 subscribes to arcv2m2 and nothing else upstream.
items: FROM arcv2m2 SEAM (via window.onGameResult): the normalized envelope { schema, gameId, mode, startedAt, finishedAt, players[], proof }. arcv2m3 reads: (a) gameId → maps to its internal GAMES config to find gameTag + scoring table, (b) players[] → finds actor='user' seat to get position, (c) proof.signature → first 8 bytes become match_ref for on-chain idempotency guard.

GAME_ID (critical input): the gameId from the envelope (e.g. 'ludo') is arcv2m3's PRIMARY KEY. arcv2m3 looks it up in its GAMES config to get: gameTag (the on-chain PDA seed), scoring table (position → points mapping), reason codes. arcv2m3 does NOT receive sourceTag from anyone — it DERIVES gameTag from gameId via its own config.
PLAYER WALLET: resolved by arcv2m2 bus as player.identity for actor='user' seats. arcv2m3 uses this to derive the on-chain PlayerPoints PDA address [gfgpoints, gameTag, player].

INFRASTRUCTURE: window.magicblockDice.recordPoints() for on-chain writes, .fetchPointsPda() for reads, .spendLocal() for spends, .matchRefFromSignature() for match_ref derivation. All gasless on the ER.

expectedOutput.summary: What arcv2m3 MUST expose for downstream modules (arcv2m4, arcv2m5, arcv2m6, UI). This is the contract arcv2m4 and other modules depend on. arcv2m4 MUST NOT duplicate arcv2m3's scoring tables or source identity logic.
items: WINDOW API (window.localPoints): the programmatic contract for downstream modules. get(gameTag) → {pureLifetime, spendableBalance, lastPoints, lastReason, lastMatchRef, lastRecordedTs, awardCount, spendCount, lastSpendTs, lastSpendRef, lastSpendReason}. fetch(gameTag) → blocking version. spend(gameTag, amount, reason, ref) → on-chain spend. subscribe(cb) → returns unsubscribe fn. lastAward/get lastSeenAward/get lastError/get lastError → ceremony state. clearTransient() → reset.

GAME_TAG (the source identity downstream modules need): arcv2m3 knows the gameTag for every award it computes (derived from gameId via its GAMES config). This gameTag is the canonical source identity that arcv2m4 SHOULD receive and store on-chain — NOT a hardcoded string. arcv2m3 exposes it in lastAward.gameTag and in the subscribe callback's first argument.

AWARD METADATA (passed to subscribers): { gameTag, points, position, reason, matchRef }. This is exactly what arcv2m4 needs to credit the global ledger. arcv2m4 should consume this from arcv2m3 (or from the shared arcv2m2 envelope) rather than recomputing it.

DOM SLOTS: [data-local-points-pure] → pureLifetime value, [data-local-points-spendable] → spendableBalance value, [data-local-points-game] → gameTag string, [data-local-points-last] → '+ N pts' or '—'. Any game page can place these slots and arcv2m3 fills them.

ON-CHAIN: PlayerPoints PDA per game per player. Seed [gfgpoints, game_tag, player_authority]. Tracks: local_pure_lifetime (u64), local_spendable_balance (u64). Metadata: last_points, last_reason, last_match_ref, last_recorded_ts, award_count, last_spend_ts, last_spend_ref, last_spend_reason, spend_count. game_tag is IN THE SEED (not stored in the account).

NO DILUTION (hard rule, output guarantee): local pure NEVER receives signup bonus, purchases, referral, giveaways, or Active Tier multiplier. Those are arcv2m6→arcv2m4 only. This is an output contract — any consumer can trust that local pure is always honest gameplay.

details: BUILD ORDER: arcv2m3 is the FIRST universal consumer of the result seam (arcv2m2) - it proves the bus end-to-end. Build after arcv2m1 (Ludo complete) + arcv2m2 (seam live). D1/D2/D3 owner-locked 2026-08-16.

TWO-TRACK DESIGN (owner decision 2026-08-16): mirrors the global arcv2m4 lifetime/spendable split but PER GAME. Track 1 LOCAL PURE = cumulative lifetime won points in that game, unspendable, undiluted (no purchase/referral/giveaway/multiplier ever here) - source of truth for native-game competency. Track 2 LOCAL SPENDABLE = the spendable split of the same wins (credited together with pure on a verified win), decremented ONLY by that game's own in-game purchases/items (S3 shop), goes up and down, never a bragging-rights number. ONE PDA holds both tracks so one account = one delegation = one onboarding fee.

PROGRAM DECISION (owner-approved, MagicBlock-researched 2026-08-16): NO new program - EXTEND the existing delegated gfg program (it is game-agnostic: game_tag is data, not code). Rationale: MagicBlock public ER nodes are gasless (tx fee 0; only session 0.0003 SOL at undelegation + commit 0.0001 SOL are paid by the sponsor/delegator, never the user). One delegated program = ONE ER session per player = ONE onboarding fee (init+delegate ~0.0086 SOL for dice+points+result), every record_points / spend_local after that is FREE. A second program would force a second delegation + second onboarding per player per game - unsustainable for 50+ games. Modularity lives in the arcv2m3 universal module (public/universal/points/) + game_tag seeds, NOT a new program.

SEEDS (D2 locked): PlayerPoints PDA = [gfgpoints, game_tag, player_authority]. game_tag ('ludo', 'ayo_olopon') isolates each game's ledger; 50+ games each get their own. D2 originally said old untagged gfgpoints PDAs (pre-module Scope B) 'become stale - wipable, no migration' - SHIPPED STRONGER (2026-08-16): the program gained a permissionless, idempotent migrate_points instruction that copies the legacy [gfgpoints, player] account (old total_points layout) into the per-game [gfgpoints, game_tag, player] ledger as BOTH tracks (1:1 split), so no lifetime points are lost across the seed change; the legacy account is left as a tombstone (never closed). All tracked devnet players migrated live. Enforced by .opencode/rules/solana-upgrade-safety.md.

ACCOUNT (PlayerPoints rework, shipped): fields local_pure_lifetime (u64), local_spendable_balance (u64), last_points, last_reason, last_match_ref (first 8 bytes of the proof-roll sig as u64), last_recorded_ts, award_count, last_spend_ts, last_spend_ref, last_spend_reason, spend_count. game_tag is IN THE SEED, not stored (a re-tag would orphan the ledger). local_ prefix reserved so arcv2m4 globals can add global_* later.

INSTRUCTIONS (same program id, deployed 2026-08-16, 22 instructions): initialize_points(game_tag), delegate_points(game_tag) (seed [gfgpoints, game_tag, authority]), record_points(game_tag, points, reason, match_ref) - credits local_pure_lifetime AND local_spendable_balance together on a verified win + duplicate-match_ref guard, NEW spend_local(game_tag, amount, reason, spend_ref) - decrements local_spendable_balance ONLY (pure untouched), InsufficientBalance guard, runs gasless on ER (session key signs, 0 SOL), NEW migrate_points(game_tag) - permissionless base-layer data-preservation migration (see SEEDS above).

RELAY: scripts/delegate-relay.mjs handleDelegate(player, gameTag='ludo') creates + delegates the tagged points PDA alongside dice + result PDAs in one idempotent call; handleMigratePoints(player, gameTag) runs the on-chain migration (sponsor pays); POST /api/delegate accepts gameTag, POST /api/migrate-points runs the migration; spend ledger + caps unchanged.

CLIENT (src/magicblock-vrf.js): recordPoints(gameTag, points, reason, matchRef) [wrapper also accepts legacy (points, reason, matchRef) -> gameTag 'ludo'], fetchPointsPda(gameTag) reads both tracks + spend audit, NEW spendLocal(gameTag, amount, reason, spendRef), claimComp(compPda, winnerIndex, gameTag), SPEND_REASONS exposed on window.

SCORING TABLE (D1 locked, Ludo - lives in the arcv2m3 module config, NOT the game; arcv2m1 never knows points rules): 4P mode -> 1st=100, 2nd=50, 3rd=10, 4th=0 (the game auto-ends once 3 winners emerge - the last seat cannot play against itself, so 4th earns nothing); 2P mode -> 1st=100 only (2P auto-ends the moment 1st emerges, so 2nd earns nothing). Graduated 4P rewards are a retention device: 'You' keeps playing for 50/10 even if not 1st. ONLY the 'You' (actor 'user') seat earns, at its own finishing position; house ('house') and local-human ('local') seats earn NOTHING even if they finish 1st. Mode derived from the envelope's players[] length (2 vs 4) - no arcv2m2 envelope change needed.

GATING: envelope.proof.signature (valid on-chain proof roll) required to bank; match_ref = first 8 bytes of that signature. IDEMPOTENT by match_ref: the module keeps a processed-match_ref set (in-memory + localStorage) so a reload or duplicate seam event never double-banks; the program guards via last_match_ref too.

NO DILUTION (hard rule): local pure NEVER receives signup bonus, purchases, referral, giveaways, Active Tier multiplier - those are arcv2m6 -> arcv2m4 only. spendable_balance only ever moves from verified local wins (credit) and that game's own spends (debit).

MODULE (public/universal/points/, game-agnostic - ANY arcv2m1 game plugs in): subscribes window.onGameResult once, computes the award from its per-game scoring config, banks via recordPoints(gameTag), exposes window.localPoints { get(gameTag) -> {pure, spendable}, spend(gameTag, amount, reason, ref), subscribe(cb) }, and fills DOM slots data-local-points-pure / data-local-points-spendable on any game page. A new game = add its scoring table to the module config + emit the seam; no game-side reward code.
ludo-lab UI: hosts the local-points display slot on the game page (pure + spendable). The game ships NO reward code (already clean: win-detection only emits the seam + Scope C result).

LEGACY (D3 locked): public/games/ludo/ is NOT touched at all - all module work targets ludo-lab only. Its pre-module record_points call (old signature) will soft-fail silently after the rework - accepted.

RECOVERY: Supabase backup is a LATER step (devnet-wipe recovery) - the on-chain records carry enough (game_tag, reason, match_ref, points) to rebuild both tracks; spend events are replayable too. Not built in the first arcv2m3 pass; tracked in the arcv2m3 build item.

TEST (benchmark = this spec): arcv2m3 module harness - simulated envelopes for 2P/4P x user 1st..4th x house/local seats -> exact award (100/50/10/0, user-only), idempotency on duplicate match_ref, spend_local decrements spendable only; on-chain ER harness (er-test pattern) - gasless record_points + spend_local on a tagged PDA from a 0-SOL session key.

[2026-08-16 hardening+display]: intermediate pre-deploy build zeroed legacy ledgers during migrate_points (read-before-write); root cause FIXED in current deployed build (read legacy fully, copy 1:1 to tagged, tombstone), ELF-verified, re-verified no-op on restored ledgers. Restore tool scripts/restore-points.mjs (explicit + --from-supabase) restores wiped/zeroed ledgers (used to restore 3 orphaned legacy accounts 400/200/5000, verified on-chain, idempotent skip-guard). Harnesses: er-points-harness.mjs PASS (gasless record_points+spend_local 0-SOL player, spendable-only decrement) + m3-module-harness.mjs 29/29 (locked scoring, user-only, idempotency, spend, resilience: retry-on-transient, confirm-timeout ledger read-back recovery, hard-failure surfacing). Display wired: module exposes lastAward + (gameTag,ledger,award) notify + re-fetch on gfg:auth-changed; global header chip via initGlobalHeader({localPointsTag}); client pointsPda(gameTag) powers the profile on-chain ledger card.

[2026-08-16 live verify + resilience]: owner re-tested the 2P win live on mobile and the +100 banked; on-chain crosscheck of the test wallet (FBWcuv...VnbCN) confirms the ludo points PDA (7aGs8riYmxQsMy1jiaGavw7Rnx6pb8gFwmC9VH4RfHDB) holds pure=100 spendable=100 award_count=1 reason=WIN_1ST bound to the proof-roll match_ref (0x136f6555f6). The root cause of the earlier silent no-show was browser-path error-swallowing (the on-chain write path itself was proven by scripts/browser-path-repro.mjs, a 0-SOL player as ER fee payer). Bank is now resilient + observable: 3x retry (idempotent via the program's DuplicateMatchRef guard), confirm-timeout recovered by re-reading the ledger, failed state surfaced via lastError + a status:'failed' notification. CEREMONY NEVER-PROMISE RULE: the ludo-lab ceremony shows '+N points loading... don't refresh the page' while the write is in flight and a neutral no-amount pending line on failure; the definitive '+N banked on-chain' appears ONLY once the write is confirmed. clearTransient() resets the award/error state on Play Again. Browser write path kept as scripts/browser-path-repro.mjs regression proof.

[2026-08-18 DISPLAY STABILITY CONTRACT (owner-approved, ludo-lab — locks the display behavior, source of truth for the fix):] window.localPoints.get(gameTag) ALWAYS background-refreshes the ledger (it never returns null without starting a fetch); the last-known ledger is rendered into the data-local-points-* DOM slots immediately on load AND on a failed/not-yet-ready refresh (no static '0 / —' text sitting in the DOM until the wallet connects); caches are WALLET-KEYED (gfg_local_points_cache_v2, wallet per user) so a shared browser can never show another signed-in user's numbers; the module re-fetches when the Dynamic session/wallet is detected as restored (bounded wallet-ready poll after DOMContentLoaded) in addition to gfg:auth-changed, because gfg:auth-changed fires only on interactive sign-in/out and a silently restored session otherwise leaves the display stuck. Reason codes are position-aware: 1st=WIN_1ST(1), 2nd=WIN_2ND(2), 3rd=WIN_3RD(3) (program stores any u8 reason; the old code labelled every placed award WIN_1ST). The ludo-lab ceremony keeps the arcv2m3 award line (lastSeenAward/lastAward + subscribe, never-promise rule).

PLAYER CORE ACCOUNT (arcv2m3, THE LAW - build against this): seed [gfgcore, player], ONE account per player, version u8 FIRST (immutable layout). Fixed Borsh layout, LEN 744: header (version u8, player Pubkey(32), created_at i64); LIVES (day i64, used u16, pool u16, unlimited_until i64, last_life_ref u64, last_life_ts i64, lives_award_count u64); GLOBAL (global_pure u64, global_lifetime u64, global_spendable u64); PREMIUM (premium_lifetime u64, premium_spendable u64, subscription_level u8, subscription_active_until i64, booster_active_until i64, last_credit_ref u64); LAST RESULT (last_match_ref u64, last_finish_digest [u8;8]); GAME BUCKETS (bucket_count u8 + buckets [GameBucket; 24]); bump u8. Replaces the six per-player PDAs (dice stays separate ONLY for VRF games).

GAME BUCKET: exactly 24 bytes = game_tag [u8;8] + local_pure u64 + local_spendable u64. Keyed by the 8-byte tag, so ADDING A GAME NEVER NEEDS A PROGRAM CHANGE and never adds an account. 24 slots in-account cover virtually every player; a rare player above 24 distinct games gets a page-2 account [gfgcore2, player]. The platform can offer 300+ games while a player still has ONE account, created once.

CORE INSTRUCTIONS: initialize_player_core (relay/sponsor, base, one-time, idempotent), delegate_player_core, undelegate_player_core (region-agnostic, in the SAME build per the RPC/region rule). The game entry points (Ludo begin_match/join_match, chess start_chess_match/join_chess_match) CHARGE the life from the core at start. record_core_points(game_tag, points, reason, match_ref) writes/updates that game bucket (idempotent by match_ref). Global and premium writes operate on the core. No per-game PDA is ever created.

CORE COST: one initialize + one delegate per player LIFETIME, about 0.0078 SOL (744-byte account), CONSTANT as the platform game count grows, versus about 0.020 SOL for the six-PDA model. Adding games costs every existing player zero.

FRONTEND UNCHANGED (owner-locked): the pages, cards, chips, buttons, and flows stay EXACTLY the same. Nothing new is shown to the player. Only the wiring behind the scenes changes: the display reads the Player Core account instead of the separate PDAs, and all writes are on-chain. Same UX, single on-chain source of truth.

ONBOARDING RETIREMENT + CORE MIGRATION (2026-09, additive): handleDelegate now creates + delegates ONLY the dice PDA [gfgplayerd, player] and the Player Core [gfgcore, player] (4 steps, about 0.010 SOL, was 12 steps and six PDAs). The retired per-game points, result, global, and premium PDAs are no longer created for new players. Existing balances move INTO the core through PERMISSIONLESS, IDEMPOTENT instructions: migrate_core_bucket(game_tag) for a per-game points ledger, migrate_core_global, migrate_core_premium. Each reads the old bytes fully, adds them to the core, then zeroes the source, so a re-run copies zero and no points are ever double-counted or lost. A v1/v2 premium account upgrades first (upgrade_premium_points_v3).

CORE SPEND INSTRUCTIONS (2026-09, additive): spend_core_local(game_tag, amount, reason, spend_ref) draws down ONLY that game bucket local spendable (never pure); spend_core_premium(amount, reason, spend_ref) draws down premium spendable (never premium_lifetime). Both gasless ER writes, mirroring the retired spend_local and spend_premium_points so live shop and premium surfaces keep working with no per-game or premium PDA.

modules.title: Global points (3 ledgers) + on-chain inventory wallet (site-wide, decoupled from gameplay)
modules.summary: M4a Global Pure (sum of arcv2m3 local wins across all games, no multiplier, honest cross-game skill total). M4b Global Lifetime (unspendable) - every point ever earned from any source. M4c Global Spendable - the spendable split of lifetime. The 2x/3x/4x multiplier applies ONLY at arcv2m4 flow-up, never on arcv2m3 or M4a. arcv2m4 ALSO owns the player's on-chain inventory/asset wallet ([gfgassets, player]): skins/items/sounds living IN the account (media bytes on-chain), the embedded wallet owns, the platform frontend views the chain bytes directly - 'the wallet is a viewer'.

expectedInput.summary: What arcv2m4 RECEIVES from upstream modules. arcv2m4 consumes the arcv2m2 seam (game wins) and receives programmatic credits from arcv2m5 (tier boosts) and arcv2m6 (signup/referral/giveaway). arcv2m4 does NOT recompute scoring or invent source identities.
items: FROM arcv2m3 (via arcv2m2 seam, the primary game-win input): when arcv2m3 banks a verified user-seat win, the arcv2m2 envelope carries: gameId (e.g. 'ludo', 'ayo_olopon'), players[] with actor='user' seat and its finishing position, proof.signature (on-chain proof, first 8 bytes become match_ref). arcv2m4 receives this envelope and MUST use gameId as the source identity. arcv2m4 must NOT duplicate arcv2m3's scoring table — arcv2m3 already computed points from position via its GAMES config. arcv2m4 is the bank, not the scorer.

FROM arcv2m5 (Active Tier) via window.globalLedger.credit(): { kind: 1, source: 'tier_boost' (arcv2m5 defines the exact tag), points: (multiplier-1)*base_points, reason: 5, matchRef }. kind=1 means M4b+M4c ONLY (never M4a pure). arcv2m4 receives this as-is and stores source on-chain.

FROM arcv2m6 (Point Sources) via window.globalLedger.credit(): { kind: 1, source: 'signup_bonus'|'referral'|'giveaway' (arcv2m6 defines exact tags), points: <amount>, reason: 2|3|4, matchRef }. kind=1 means M4b+M4c ONLY (never M4a pure). arcv2m4 receives this as-is and stores source on-chain.

CRITICAL RULE (learned from the source_tag bug, fixed 2026-08-17): arcv2m4 must NEVER duplicate arcv2m3's scoring table or invent source identity strings. arcv2m4 reads arcv2m3's lastAward (gameTag, points, reason) — arcv2m3 is the scorer, arcv2m4 is the bank. For kind=0 game wins, arcv2m4 maps gameTag to source_code (u8 enum) and passes it to the program. expectedOutput.summary: What arcv2m4 MUST expose for downstream modules (arcv2m5, arcv2m6, arcv2m7, UI). This is the contract that arcv2m5/arcv2m6 call into for credits and spends.
items: WINDOW API (window.globalLedger): the programmatic contract. get() → {pureLifetime, lifetime, spendableBalance, lastSource, lastPoints, lastReason, lastMatchRef, lastRecordedTs, awardCount, spendCount, ...}. fetch() → blocking version. credit({source, kind, points, reason, matchRef}) → on-chain credit (arcv2m5/arcv2m6 call this). spend(amount, reason, ref) → on-chain spend. subscribe(cb) → returns unsubscribe fn. lastCredit/get lastSeenCredit/get lastError → ceremony state. clearTransient() → reset.

CREDIT API (the key downstream contract): window.globalLedger.credit({source, kind, points, reason, matchRef}) — this is how arcv2m5 (tier boost) and arcv2m6 (signup/referral/giveaway) add points to arcv2m4. arcv2m4 stores source on-chain as-is. kind=0 (game win) credits M4a+M4b+M4c. kind=1 (other) credits M4b+M4c only.

ON-CHAIN: GlobalPoints PDA per player. Seed [gfgpoints, 'global', player_authority]. Tracks: global_pure_lifetime (u64), global_lifetime (u64), global_spendable_balance (u64). Metadata: last_source (u8 source_code enum stored on-chain), last_points, last_reason, last_match_ref, last_recorded_ts, award_count, last_spend_ts, last_spend_ref, last_spend_reason, spend_count.

DOM SLOTS: [data-global-pure] → pureLifetime, [data-global-lifetime] → lifetime, [data-global-spendable] → spendableBalance, [data-global-last] → '+ N pts' or '—'. Any page can place these and arcv2m4 fills them.

FLOW-UP GUARANTEE (output contract): M4a pure is NEVER multiplied or bonus-inflated. Multiplier (arcv2m5) applies only to M4b+M4c as kind=1 credits. arcv2m6 sources apply only to M4b+M4c as kind=1 credits. Any consumer can trust that global_pure_lifetime = sum of verified game wins across all games, period.

details: M4a GLOBAL PURE: strictly the sum of arcv2m3 local wins across all games. No multiplier, no purchases, no bonus. The honest 'how good are you across the whole platform' number.
M4b GLOBAL LIFETIME (unspendable): every point ever earned from ANY source (game wins, signup bonus, giveaways, referral, sub multiplier). Permanent reputation/level number.
M4c GLOBAL SPENDABLE: the spendable split of lifetime. Purchases, Active Tier buys, comp entries, cosmetics all flow here. Goes up and down.
Active Tier 2x/3x/4x multiplier applies ONLY at arcv2m4 flow-up (lifetime + spendable), NEVER on arcv2m3 local or M4a pure.

Source-tagged: every arcv2m4 credit carries its game/event source. For game wins (kind=0), the source IS the gameId from the arcv2m2 envelope (e.g. 'ludo'). For other credits (kind=1), the source is the tag from arcv2m5/arcv2m6 (e.g. 'signup_bonus', 'referral', 'tier_boost'). The program stores source as a u8 at last_source. FIXED (2026-08-17): changed source_tag parameter from String to u8 enum (source_code) in the program, with explicit codes (1=ludo, 2=ayo_olopon, 10=signup_bonus, 11=referral, 12=giveaway, 13=tier_boost). No layout change needed (still u8 at offset 32). arcv2m4 client no longer duplicates arcv2m3's scoring table — reads arcv2m3's lastAward (gameTag, points, reason) and maps gameTag to source_code.

ON-CHAIN (owner-locked 2026-08-16): the 3 global ledgers live on-chain via the SAME delegated gfg program, NOT in Supabase. Reuse the arcv2m3 decision: one delegated program = one ER session per player = one onboarding fee; every record_global / spend_global is gasless on the ER (session key signs, 0 fees). No new program.

SEED (fits the existing per-game scheme, game_tag is data not code): GlobalPoints PDA = [gfgpoints, 'global', player_authority] - the reserved 'global' tag, documented so no future game uses it. NEW separate account type (GlobalPoints layout: global_pure_lifetime, global_lifetime, global_spendable_balance, last_source, last_points, last_reason, last_match_ref, last_recorded_ts, award_count, last_spend_*, spend_count) - do NOT extend the PlayerPoints layout (upgrade-safety R2: layouts are versioned; a separate account avoids touching the live arcv2m3 schema). No migration needed: the old single global_points/lifetime_points was Supabase-only, there is no legacy on-chain global account.

INSTRUCTIONS (same program id, new capability): initialize_global_points, delegate_global_points (seed [gfgpoints, 'global', authority]), record_global_points(kind u8, source_code u8, points, reason, match_ref) where kind 0 = GAME WIN (credits M4a pure + M4b lifetime + M4c spendable) and kind 1 = OTHER credit (signup_bonus/referral/giveaway - credits M4b + M4c ONLY, never M4a pure), duplicate match_ref guard; source_code enum: 1=ludo, 2=ayo_olopon, 10=signup_bonus, 11=referral, 12=giveaway, 13=tier_boost. arcv2m4 reads arcv2m3's lastAward and maps gameTag to source_code; spend_global(amount, reason, spend_ref) decrements M4c spendable ONLY (M4a/M4b untouched), InsufficientBalance guard, idempotent spend_ref. All gasless on the ER.

FLOW-UP CONTRACT (multiplier-blind arcv2m4 - best option): arcv2m4 does NOT know tiers. The Active Tier 2x/3x/4x multiplier lives in arcv2m5 and is applied as a SECOND, distinct credit through the same API: arcv2m4 subscribes to the seam and banks the BASE unmultiplied win into M4a+M4b+M4c; arcv2m5's tier driver then records the boost as its own credit (source_code 13=tier_boost, kind 1, points = (multiplier-1)*base) into M4b+M4c only. M4a pure therefore can NEVER be multiplied, by construction. Both writes are gasless; both idempotent by match_ref.

MODULE (public/universal/ledgers/, game-agnostic): subscribes window.onGameResult once for the base win credit; exposes window.globalLedger = { get() -> {pure, lifetime, spendable}, credit({source, kind, points, matchRef}), spend(amount, reason, ref), subscribe(cb) } so arcv2m5/arcv2m6/arcv2m7 drive boosts/credits/spends through one API. Mirror of the arcv2m3 module patterns (retry, confirm-timeout read-back recovery, never-promise display).

SUPABASE ROLE (owner decision 2026-08-16): backup/restore ONLY for devnet-wipe recovery before mainnet (same recovery model as arcv2m3's restore tool). It is never the live source of truth for any ledger.
Current state to change: today there is ONE global_points + lifetime_points on the profile and a single point_transactions ledger; this becomes the 3-ledger arcv2m4 model.

ORDERING: arcv2m4 consumes the result seam (arcv2m2) so it must be live before arcv2m5 money work - build after arcv2m3 is stable/verified for Ludo, before arcv2m5. Already the build order (arcv2m1+arcv2m2+arcv2m3 -> arcv2m4 -> arcv2m5).

ON-CHAIN INVENTORY + ASSETS (owner-locked 2026-08-17, feasibility MagicBlock-researched): the player's on-chain item wallet - skins, cosmetics, items, sounds. The 'wallet is a viewer' model: the account IS the source of truth for BOTH ownership and (by default) the media bytes; the embedded wallet owns it, the platform frontend reads the account and renders the media directly (open the on-chain image/sound and see it, no external host in the path). Feasibility proven by MagicBlock docs + samples: the ER executes any Solana account model gasless (ER lifecycle: tx fee 0, ~50ms slots, ~100ms confirm; pricing: base 0 per tx, 0.0003 SOL per ER session at undelegation, 0.0001 SOL per commit, VRF on ER free); Solana Generals generates its map via an ER transaction (fully on-chain game, 100% serverless); Magic UNO deals/plays/draws every card on-chain gasless with VRF shuffles; Session Keys are the documented pattern for 'in-app NFTs purchase' (scoped, time-limited, gasless); the MagicBlock Asset Manager SDK ships exactly this storage pattern - 'store assets (images, animations, sounds, JSON metadata) directly in an Assets account on the ER' (base64 compression, IPFS optional, DApp loads assets directly from the ER). No new program - same delegated gfg program, one ER session per player, every grant/equip gasless.

ASSET ACCOUNT (PlayerAssets): PDA [gfgassets, player_authority], NEW seed prefix gfgassets (immutable, upgrade-safety R1), site-wide (a skin owned once is owned across games; per-game scoping is an entry field, NOT the seed). Layout versioned from day one (R2): version u8, item_count u16, entries[] {asset_id u64, game_tag [u8;16], media_type u8 (png/webp/ogg/mp3/json), w u16, h u16, byte_len u32, data_offset u32, state u8 (owned/equipped/revoked), unlock_ts i64} + a media blob region holding the raw bytes (base64/compressed). Reads use getAccountInfo dataSlice so the profile fetches only one asset's byte range, never the whole account (read latency stays low regardless of account size).

MEDIA-IN-ACCOUNT POLICY (owner decision): item media bytes live IN the account by default (the viewer opens the on-chain bytes directly - no IPFS/CDN simplification). Large full-res blobs (> ~128KB) become entry references (URL/CID) with ownership + entitlement still on-chain. Devnet = $0 at any size (faucet); mainnet cost = rent-exempt 0.00000696 SOL/byte (refundable if the account closes) + sponsor-absorbed session/commit micro-costs - so keep per-asset media lean and defer the size call until user counts are real. The account model is identical either way: zero rebuild, this is the mainnet-ready answer.

INSTRUCTIONS (same program id, new capability, all gasless on the ER via the player's session key): initialize_assets, delegate_assets (seed [gfgassets, authority]), grant_asset(asset_id, media_type, w, h, data) - atomically writes an entry + its media bytes, update_asset_state(asset_id, state) - equip/unequip/revoke, add_asset_media(asset_id, offset, chunk) - chunked write for larger blobs. Ownership is program-enforced: only the account authority (session key) mutates.

MODULE (public/universal/assets/, game-agnostic, part of arcv2m4): window.gfgAssets = { list() -> owned items, open(assetId) -> {mediaType, blobUrl} (reads the account bytes with a sliced read, decodes, returns an object URL the UI renders in /

[2026-08-18 arcv2m4 FLOW-UP + DISPLAY STABILITY CONTRACT (owner-approved, ludo-lab — locks the behavior, source of truth for the fix):] arcv2m4 credits the GLOBAL ledger from the SAME seam envelope arcv2m3 banks from, with the award resolved by CROSS-MODULE match_ref (window.globalLedger never blindly credits): arcv2m4 reads arcv2m3's lastSeenAward/lastAward and accepts one ONLY when its match_ref equals THIS envelope's proof match_ref (bounded ~2s poll after the bus fires), so arcv2m4 banks exactly when arcv2m3 banks and can never credit a stale/other match's award. window.globalLedger.get() ALWAYS background-refreshes; the last-known ledger is rendered into [data-global-*] slots on load and on failed/wallet-not-ready refresh; cache is WALLET-KEYED (gfg_global_ledger_cache_v2); the module re-fetches on wallet-ready (bounded poll) + gfg:auth-changed. SITE-WIDE LOADING: the global-ledger module is loaded on EVERY page via the shared header (header.js injects it when absent) because the header pill is on every page and otherwise sits on 'Loading…' permanently on pages without the module. The ludo-lab result ceremony shows an arcv2m4 credit line next to the arcv2m3 award line (banking / neutral pending / '+N global points banked on-chain', never-promise rule) and Play Again clears arcv2m4 transient state too.
PLAYER CORE: the three global ledgers now live INSIDE the single Player Core account (arcv2m3), not a separate per-player PDA. Same gasless ER writes; fewer accounts.

The subscription powers the 2x win multiplier at arcv2m4 flow-up, the boosted daily reward and the bigger lives pool (both in arcv2m10). Non-cancellable, non-refundable. items: PREMIUM LEDGER (on-chain, gasless ER, same program id, NO new program): PDA [gfgprem, player_authority], immutable NEW seed prefix gfgprem (upgrade-safety R1), versioned layout (version u8 FIRST, R2). Fields: premium_lifetime u64 (never spendable), premium_spendable u64 (spendable), subscription_level u8 (0=free, 2=Level 2), subscription_active_until i64 (unix ts, hard 30-day window, NO auto-renew), last_credit_ts i64, last_credit_points u64, last_credit_ref u64, last_spend_ts i64, last_spend_ref u64, last_spend_reason u8, spend_count u64.

MULTIPLIER AT arcv2m4 FLOW-UP ONLY: on each verified seam event while the sub is active, arcv2m5 applies window.globalLedger.credit({kind:1, source:'tier_boost', points:(multiplier-1)*base, reason:5, matchRef}). arcv2m5 never touches arcv2m3 or M4a pure (they stay honest).

RECEIPT/LOG CONTRACT (hard): every activation records WHEN the token credit happened, the AMOUNT (5,000P), and the active-sub window (start + 30-day expiry) in a durable log (on-chain last_credit_* in the PDA + a Supabase audit row keyed by credit_ref). The profile page shows the active sub, days left, and the credit/activation history.

details: LOCKED LAUNCH PLANS (owner-approved 2026-08-20, plan ladder + prices updated 2026-08-22): the ladder is CONFIG-DRIVEN (more levels = data, never code). Launch ships Level-2 (2x) and Level-3 (3x). Level-2: real price $10 / 30 days, launch discount global $5, Nigeria beta N5,000 (was $3 / N4,000); the on-chain plan cost stays a fixed 5,000P. Level-3: actual $20, discount $10 / N13,500, Nigeria N8,000, activation premium cost TBD (proposed 10,000P). Digital membership, NON-cancellable and NON-refundable. The player pays via the payment processor on the site, support verifies, then credits the FULL 5,000 premium points on-chain (the discount never reduces what the chain recognizes; on-chain cost of 2x is 5,000P).

PREMIUM POINTS (owner 'payment onchain' decision): two tracks with NO free entry. premium_lifetime = a credential you keep forever (never spent, not a gameplay number). premium_spendable = what actually buys things. Acquired ONLY by direct purchase (admin credit). DUAL POWER: premium spendable is accepted anywhere global spendable is accepted AND in places global spendable can NEVER go: subscription activation and unlimited-life upgrades. Premium points never merge into global lifetime/spendable (arcv2m4) and never touch local (arcv2m3) or M4a pure.

SUBSCRIPTION STATE ON-CHAIN (not Supabase as truth): subscription_level + active_until live in the premium PDA, so any page reads the truth from the chain gaslessly. Supabase keeps only the payment/affiliate relationship + audit rows.

MULTIPLIER LADDER: launch ships Level 2 (2x). Future ladder (when tiers reopen): 2x/3x/4x/5x, i.e. a 100P base win banks 200/300/400/500. Applied ONLY at arcv2m4 flow-up as kind=1 tier_boost. Base unmultiplied wins already bank in arcv2m4 via the seam.

DAILY REWARD (arcv2m10, subscription-boosted, owner numbers 2026-08-20): free tier claims 25P once per day (must be signed in; 24h reset enforced, also via Dynamic sign-out). Level-2 subscriber claims 200P/day. Owner marketing note: frame the Level-2 daily jump as a strong upsell hook - it feeds the earn-competition feel and encourages the upgrade.

LIVES (arcv2m10, subscription-boosted, owner numbers 2026-08-20): free = 5 lives/day, Level 2 = 10 lives/day (5 base + 5 premium). Daily reset at GMT+00 (midnight UTC). A life is consumed ONLY when a match COMPLETES (a finished game); abandon, reset, and mid-game network disconnect NEVER cost a life. Universal: applies to Ludo 2P/4P and every future arcv2m1 game.

AFFILIATE (arcv2m6, launch marketing - 12 MONTHS, owner 2026-08-21): each user gets a unique referral code. When a referred player activates a paid subscription, the referrer earns 15% of that subscription on-chain, recurs for every monthly subscription the referral buys for up to 12 months after their first. HARDSHOT GATE: the referrer must hold an ACTIVE Level-2 subscription at the month the referral's payment activates, otherwise that month's 15% share is FORFEITED (never back-paid). PERMANENT PAIR FORFEIT: if the referral makes 2 consecutive subscription-payment periods (about 60 days) while the referrer was inactive, that specific affiliate->referral pair is closed permanently; even later via resubscription the referrer cannot resume earnings from that referred account. Any shorter inactive gap just pauses, and accruals resume from the next payment made while the referrer is active again (a payment made during an inactive month never accrues). AMOUNTS PEGGED TO USD: store every accrual on-chain in USD cents (15% of $3 = $0.45) so future price rises are automatic, and convert to Naira only at manual payout using that day's rate. ON-CHAIN AUDIT (immutable, sponsor/relay signs): per-affiliate ledger records each month's eligibility (active/inactive), the USD amount, status earned/pending/paid/forfeited, and withdrawals, so no one can accuse the platform of manipulating or not paying earnings. Payout manual (owner pays offline) within 3-7 days; automated later. Profile shows accruals and a withdraw control later.

UNLIMITED LIFE BOOSTER (arcv2m5, premium-purchased, owner 2026-08-21, PRICE 2026-08-22): $1 / 500P for 72 hours (3 days) of unlimited play, universal across every game on any plan (free or Level-2). Point base value is $0.002 per point (international USD rate, never Naira), so $1 = 500 points and $2 = 1,000 points; the booster costs 500P (= $1). Countdown starts only when the player taps Activate. NO win multiplier (owner: money buys time, never points; a multiplier may come later only if players ask). Points keep exact normal rates; pure local (arcv2m3) always untouched; global lifetime/spendable only grow from real wins. Value is time to play more and win more in the daily earn window (mastery-based). Purchase flow mirrors the sub: pay -> support verifies -> premium points credited at $0.002/pt -> Activate spends premium -> booster_active_until = now + 72h stored in the premium PDA; arcv2m10 lives shows UNLIMITED with a live countdown while active. PROGRAM: PremiumPoints v3 adds booster_active_until i64 via the same permissionless migration pattern as v2 (upgrade-safe), so the booster state is read by arcv2m10 and any module, like on-chain metadata.

EARN COMPETITION (arcv2m7, launch simplest - owner model 2026-08-21): ONE ENTRY PER PLAYER ACCOUNT PER WINDOW (no tickets, one membership). To enter: an ACTIVE Level-2 subscription (required) + a one-time spendable entry paid at unlock from the player's ledgers (base entry 500P global spendable, any spendable family works: global/local/premium). The entry list is DYNAMIC and PLUGGABLE so ANY platform feature can be an extra requirement later (e.g. also 100P local spendable, or a 'won {game} before' proof via local pure, etc.) without changing the competition core. LEADERBOARD IS WINDOW-FRESH: only verified game wins made after the window starts and before it expires count; pre-window and post-window points are ZERO for that board (10,000 historical points = 0 until they win inside the window). Applies only to the selected game (Ludo at launch; more added later). DAILY POOL (2026-08-21): $1-equivalent per day, Nigeria launch N1,500: 1st N500 cash, 2nd N300 cash, 3rd N200 cash, 4th-8th N100 airtime each. Price-agnostic (stored in USD cents) so payouts can later be stablecoin/embedded-wallet. Same account cannot take multiple ranks in a window; separate accounts each need their own sub + point payments + in-window grinding. Manual payout (cash/airtime) from the owner; optionally a daily profile win-eligibility form. The daily pool is sustained by active subscriptions alone, so only paying players join.

CANNOT-FORGO AT LAUNCH (owner list 2026-08-20): the game itself, local points, global points, premium points, subscription (with all it needs to deliver: 12-month affiliate, pay within 3-7 days, Paystack manual-transfer-only, receipts/logs of token credit + amount + active sub), and the simplest earn competition.

PAYMENT PIPE (lock at build): Paystack embed -> manual bank transfer ONLY (cards disabled at Paystack setup) -> player sees a temporary Paystack account -> pays -> emails receipt -> owner verifies -> admin-only credit page banks premium points + activates subscription on-chain -> receipt log + Supabase audit row. The owner supplies the Paystack embed code at build time.
